title: Inside the mirror
description:
This is the heart of that project, a maze generator script. Which gets a 3d model and work around it measures to make a procedural maze.

*You set the model that will made the wall, and you can as well put some variations as seen in Wall 2

*It measures the model and then you define how many rows and columns it'll have in X Size and Y Size

And in the video you can see it running going through the steps as mentioned.

title: NOTE RUSH 37
description: o note rush virou firmware: o jogo de leitura de notas rodando direto num teclado MIDI, o M-Vave SMK-37, feito em cima do Vector37 do genkigenki. lê a letra, lê a pauta ou ouve a nota e toca nas teclas; acerto faz combo com raio saindo da tela e passando pelos pads, e o placar fica no top 5 do próprio teclado. dá pra testar no navegador (o firmware de verdade, compilado pra WebAssembly) e instalar pela mesma página.
